lines.en: Don't think you can run away…
This street is mine. Go around.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶嘶，这里是我的地盘……

lines.en: Boots crunch glass. Don't look back...

lines.zh: 我沿着废墟跟了你三条街……
lines.en: I've trailed you three streets through rubble...

lines.zh: 包里的东西，迟早是我的……
lines.en: What's in your bag is mine eventually...

lines.zh: 他腰上有水壶，我看见了。
lines.en: He has a canteen at his belt; I saw it.
Catch him, don't let him run!
Keep an eye on him, don't let him escape!
Watch him, don't let him escape!
Capture him, don't let him escape!
Follow me, the treasure is here.
Watch out, I'm coming for you.
Get out of my way, or die.
My legs are whole; I can catch you.

lines.zh: 你踩到了我藏东西的砖。
lines.en: You stepped on the brick hiding my stash.
Retreat, or I'll cut you down.

lines.zh: 这条巷子只够一个人过。
lines.en: This alley only fits one at a time.

lines.zh: 末世里，找个能一起翻箱子。
lines.en: In this wasteland, someone to loot with.

lines.zh: 两个人的手，够撬开一扇门。
lines.en: Two pairs of hands can pry open a door.

lines.zh: 这身破布，也想有人并肩。
lines.en: Even in these rags, I want someone beside me.

lines.zh: 末世里，抢东西比什么都重要。
lines.en: In this world, looting comes first.
The time to mate has come.
Every bag I search turns out empty.
Even the end times need offspring.
Find a partner and survive the winter.

lines.zh: 这些都是我曾经的财宝！

lines.en: My pack is empty; yours will fill it.
This meat will carry me a long way.
That pack of yours looks suspicious...
Run. I know these ruins better...
I'll break your leg so I don't have to chase...

lines.zh: 血腥味从你身上飘过来……
别躲进那栋楼，我知道后门……
lines.en: Don't hide in that building. I know the back door...

lines.zh: 你腿上的血，滴到我这了。
lines.en: The blood from your leg dripped onto me.

lines.zh: 我数着你还有几发子弹。
lines.en: I'm counting the rounds you have left.

lines.zh: 你在我眼中不过是个虫子！
lines.en: You're just a bug to me.

lines.zh: 我的刀刃将带走你的生命！
lines.en: My blade will take your life.

lines.zh: 我的死亡将带走你的灵魂！
lines.en: My death will take your soul.
Count to three and you drop...
My blade points at your knee...
I've held this breath a long time...

lines.zh: 绷带用完的人撑不过下一刀……
lines.en: Someone out of bandages won't take another cut...

lines.zh: 你在流血，我知道你跑不远……
lines.en: You're bleeding. You won't get far...
Soft steps. I'll come around your blind side...
I wait for you to push that door...
A twist of the wrist and the blade goes in...

lines.zh: 我看着你的影子在墙上晃……
lines.en: I watch your shadow sway on the wall...
This fist lands by your ear.
Feel the power of my claws!

lines.zh: 你离死亡这么近，感受到恐惧了吗？
lines.en: You're so close to death, can you feel the fear?
A brick comes off the wall at you.
My teeth will tear you apart!

lines.zh: 我的牙咬进衣服，血就流开了！
lines.en: My teeth go through cloth and the blood starts flowing!
I'm here to harvest your soul!
I grab the strap of your pack.
Bite down, and you start bleeding...

lines.zh: 刀刃卡在骨头里，我拧一下……
lines.en: The blade sticks in bone. I twist...

lines.zh: 膝盖一弯，你站不起来了……
lines.en: Your knee buckles. You won't stand...
I rub dirt into your wound...
This cut will rot you slowly...

lines.zh: 黑暗中，我的眼睛盯着你！
lines.en: In the dark, my eyes are on you!

lines.zh: 这条街的箱子，都归我翻。
lines.en: Every crate on this street is mine to search.
The scent of prey, I smell it!

lines.zh: 黑暗中，我的灵魂在寻找猎物！
lines.en: In the dark, my soul seeks prey!

lines.zh: 寂静的夜晚，我的号角响起！
从倒塌的便利店后门出来……
lines.en: Out the back of a collapsed store...
A whistle drifts through the ruins...

lines.zh: 我在废弃加油站过了夜……
lines.en: I spent the night at the dead gas station...
That fire on the corner is mine...
Flames are licking my trouser leg...
Everything I looted just blew apart.
An arrow is buried in my shoulder...
Too hungry to hold my knife steady...
I'm falling with no bottom in sight...
